title: PhD Position in Multimodal AI and Intent Recognition
description: We are seeking a highly motivated PhD candidate to research uncertainty-aware few-shot user adaptation for multimodal intent recognition. The project involves working with visual and textual data. Requirements: Master's in Artificial Intelligence or Computer Science, strong Python programming, and experience with computer vision and vector databases (e.g., Qdrant).

title: PhD in Financial Market Analysis using Machine Learning
description: This PhD project explores the application of Hidden Markov Models (HMM) and regime-switching algorithms to detect financial market stress. The candidate will work extensively with time-series data and predictive modeling. Requirements: Proficiency in Python, algorithm development (MQL5 or Pine Script), and a strong mathematical optimization background (Gauss-Newton, Line Search).
